[Corporate Joint Venture](/1943274/1794896/fasb-asc-publication/corporate-joint-venture "A corporation owned and operated by a small group of entities \(the joint venturers\) as a separate and specific business or project for the mutual benefit of the members of the group. A government may also be a member of the group. The purpose of a corporate joint venture frequently is to share risks and rewards in developing a new market, product or technology; to combine complementary technological knowledge; or to pool resources in developing production or other facilities. A corporate joint venture also usually provides an arrangement under which each joint venturer may participate, directly or indirectly, in the overall management of the joint venture. Joint venturers thus have an interest or relationship other than as passive investors. An entity that is a subsidiary of one of the joint venturers is not a corporate joint venture. The ownership of a corporate joint venture seldom changes, and its stock is usually not traded publicly. A noncontrolling interest held by public ownership, however, does not preclude a corporation from being a corporate joint venture.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2023-05](/1943274/3034434/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2023-05%E2%80%94business-combinations%E2%80%94joint-venture-formations-subtopic-805-60-recognition-and-initial-measurement#GUID-F399620F-8ECF-4FFC-9E21-D80C30DEA8EC)| 08/23/2023  
[Direct Financing Lease](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets none of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 but meets the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-3\(b\)and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.")| Amended| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2021-05](/1943274/1856921/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2021-05%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-lessors%E2%80%94certain-leases-with-variable-lease-payments#GUID-2983E3EE-5A67-4114-8AB0-4589AB23A029)| 07/19/2021  
[Direct Financing Lease](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets none of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 but meets the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-3\(b\)and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Discount Rate for the Lease](/1943274/1798211/fasb-asc-publication/discount-rate-for-the-lease "For a lessee, the discount rate for the lease is the rate implicit in the lease unless that rate cannot be readily determined. In that case, the lessee is required to use its incremental borrowing rate. For a lessor, the discount rate for the lease is the rate implicit in the lease.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Fair Value](/1943274/1801222/fasb-asc-publication/fair-value "The price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date.") (2nd def.)| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Finance Lease](/1943274/1801775/fasb-asc-publication/finance-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Incremental Borrowing Rate](/1943274/1806214/fasb-asc-publication/incremental-borrowing-rate "The rate of interest that a lessee would have to pay to borrow on a collateralized basis over a similar term an amount equal to the lease payments in a similar economic environment.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Initial Direct Costs](/1943274/1806795/fasb-asc-publication/initial-direct-costs "Incremental costs of a lease that would not have been incurred if the lease had not been obtained.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Joint Venture](/1943274/1808367/fasb-asc-publication/joint-venture "An entity owned and operated by a small group of businesses \(the joint venturers\) as a separate and specific business or project for the mutual benefit of the members of the group. A government may also be a member of the group. The purpose of a joint venture frequently is to share risks and rewards in developing a new market, product, or technology; to combine complementary technological knowledge; or to pool resources in developing production or other facilities. A joint venture also usually provides an arrangement under which each joint venturer may participate, directly or indirectly, in the overall management of the joint venture. Joint venturers thus have an interest or relationship other than as passive investors. An entity that is a subsidiary of one of the joint venturers is not a joint venture. The ownership of a joint venture seldom changes, and its equity interests usually are not traded publicly. A minority public ownership, however, does not preclude an entity from being a joint venture. As distinguished from a corporate joint venture, a joint venture is not limited to corporate entities.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2023-05](/1943274/3034434/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2023-05%E2%80%94business-combinations%E2%80%94joint-venture-formations-subtopic-805-60-recognition-and-initial-measurement#GUID-F399620F-8ECF-4FFC-9E21-D80C30DEA8EC)| 08/23/2023  
[Lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Lease Liability](/1943274/1808833/fasb-asc-publication/lease-liability "A lessee's obligation to make the lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Lease Modification](/1943274/1808859/fasb-asc-publication/lease-modification "A change to the terms and conditions of a contract that results in a change in the scope of or the consideration for a lease \(for example, a change to the terms and conditions of the contract that adds or terminates the right to use one or more underlying assets or extends or shortens the contractual lease term\).")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Lease Payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Lease Term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Legal Entity](/1943274/1808975/fasb-asc-publication/legal-entity "Any legal structure used to conduct activities or to hold assets. Some examples of such structures are corporations, partnerships, limited liability companies, grantor trusts, and other trusts.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Market Participants](/1943274/1810868/fasb-asc-publication/market-participants "Buyers and sellers in the principal \(or most advantageous\) market for the asset or liability that have all of the following characteristics: They are independent of each other, that is, they are not related parties, although the price in a related-party transaction may be used as an input to a fair value measurement if the reporting entity has evidence that the transaction was entered into at market terms They are knowledgeable, having a reasonable understanding about the asset or liability and the transaction using all available information, including information that might be obtained through due diligence efforts that are usual and customary They are able to enter into a transaction for the asset or liability They are willing to enter into a transaction for the asset or liability, that is, they are motivated but not forced or otherwise compelled to do so.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Monetary Liability](/1943274/1811847/fasb-asc-publication/monetary-liability "An obligation to pay a sum of money the amount of which is fixed or determinable without reference to future prices of specific goods and services.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Not-for-Profit Entity](/1943274/1814039/fasb-asc-publication/not-for-profit-entity "An entity that possesses the following characteristics, in varying degrees, that distinguish it from a business entity: Contributions of significant amounts of resources from resource providers who do not expect commensurate or proportionate pecuniary return Operating purposes other than to provide goods or services at a profit Absence of ownership interests like those of business entities. Entities that clearly fall outside this definition include the following: All investor-owned entities Entities that provide dividends, lower costs, or other economic benefits directly and proportionately to their owners, members, or participants, such as mutual insurance entities, credit unions, farm and rural electric cooperatives, and employee benefit plans.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Operating Lease](/1943274/1814638/fasb-asc-publication/operating-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, any lease other than a finance lease. From the perspective of a lessor, any lease other than a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Orderly Transaction](/1943274/1814808/fasb-asc-publication/orderly-transaction "A transaction that assumes exposure to the market for a period before the measurement date to allow for marketing activities that are usual and customary for transactions involving such assets or liabilities; it is not a forced transaction \(for example, a forced liquidation or distress sale\).")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Probable](/1943274/1818955/fasb-asc-publication/probable "The future event or events are likely to occur.") (2nd def.)| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Rate Implicit in the Lease](/1943274/1821062/fasb-asc-publication/rate-implicit-in-the-lease "The rate of interest that, at a given date, causes the aggregate present value of \(a\) the lease paymentsand \(b\) the amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease termto equal the sum of \(1\) the fair value of the underlying asset minus any related investment tax credit retained and expected to be realized by the lessor and \(2\) any deferred initial direct costs of the lessor. However, if the rate determined in accordance with the preceding sentence is less than zero, a rate implicit in the lease of zero shall be used.")| Amended| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2018-10](/1943274/1856099/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2018-10%E2%80%94codification-improvements-to-topic-842-leases#GUID-FCFB1422-C6D8-483E-A0E4-ECF9FA0783C7)| 07/18/2018  
[Rate Implicit in the Lease](/1943274/1821062/fasb-asc-publication/rate-implicit-in-the-lease "The rate of interest that, at a given date, causes the aggregate present value of \(a\) the lease paymentsand \(b\) the amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease termto equal the sum of \(1\) the fair value of the underlying asset minus any related investment tax credit retained and expected to be realized by the lessor and \(2\) any deferred initial direct costs of the lessor. However, if the rate determined in accordance with the preceding sentence is less than zero, a rate implicit in the lease of zero shall be used.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Related Parties](/1943274/1821980/fasb-asc-publication/related-parties "Related parties include: Affiliates of the entity Entities for which investments in their equity securities would be required, absent the election of the fair value option under the Fair Value Option Subsection of Section 825-10-15, to be accounted for by the equity method by the investing entity Trusts for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of management Principal owners of the entity and members of their immediate families Management of the entity and members of their immediate families Other parties with which the entity may deal if one party controls or can significantly influence the management or operating policies of the other to an extent that one of the transacting parties might be prevented from fully pursuing its own separate interests Other parties that can significantly influence the management or operating policies of the transacting parties or that have an ownership interest in one of the transacting parties and can significantly influence the other to an extent that one or more of the transacting parties might be prevented from fully pursuing its own separate interests.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Residual Value Guarantee](/1943274/1823121/fasb-asc-publication/residual-value-guarantee "A guarantee made to a lessor that the value of an underlying asset returned to the lessor at the end of a lease will be at least a specified amount.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Right-of-Use Asset](/1943274/1824127/fasb-asc-publication/right-of-use-asset "An asset that represents a lessee's right to use an underlying asset for the lease term.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Sales-Type Lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.")| Amended| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2021-05](/1943274/1856921/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2021-05%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-lessors%E2%80%94certain-leases-with-variable-lease-payments#GUID-2983E3EE-5A67-4114-8AB0-4589AB23A029)| 07/19/2021  
[Sales-Type Lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Short-Term Lease](/1943274/1826141/fasb-asc-publication/short-term-lease "A lease that, at the commencement date, has a lease term of 12 months or less and does not include an option to purchase the underlying asset that the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Sublease](/1943274/1827695/fasb-asc-publication/sublease "A transaction in which an underlying asset is re-leased by the lessee \(or intermediate lessor\) to a third party \(the sublessee\) and the original \(or head\) lease between the lessor and the lessee remains in effect.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Underlying Asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016  
[Useful Life](/1943274/1831647/fasb-asc-publication/useful-life "The period over which an asset is expected to contribute directly or indirectly to future cash flows.")| Added| [Accounting Standards Update No. 2016-02](/1943274/1855311/fasb-asc-publication/accounting-standards-update-no-2016-02%E2%80%94leases-topic-842-#GUID-4073757B-B23C-4931-ABE0-8A1DF61EAFEA)| 02/25/2016

# 05 Overview and Background

General Note:

The Overview and Background Section provides overview and background material for the guidance contained in the Subtopic. It does not provide the historical background or due process. It may contain certain material that users generally consider useful to understand the typical situations addressed by the standards. The Section does not summarize the accounting and reporting requirements.

## General

842-20-05-1

This Subtopic addresses accounting by [lessees](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") for [leases](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") that have been classified as [finance leases](/1943274/1801775/fasb-asc-publication/finance-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2.") or [operating leases](/1943274/1814638/fasb-asc-publication/operating-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, any lease other than a finance lease. From the perspective of a lessor, any lease other than a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease.") in accordance with the requirements in Subtopic 842-10. Lessees shall follow the requirements in this Subtopic as well as those in Subtopic 842-10.

842-20-05-1

This Subtopic addresses accounting by [lessees](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") for [leases](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") that have been classified as [finance leases](/1943274/1801775/fasb-asc-publication/finance-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2.") or [operating leases](/1943274/1814638/fasb-asc-publication/operating-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, any lease other than a finance lease. From the perspective of a lessor, any lease other than a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease.") in accordance with the requirements in Subtopic 842-10. Lessees shall follow the requirements in this Subtopic as well as those in Subtopic 842-10.

# 15 Scope and Scope Exceptions

General Note:

The Scope and Scope Exceptions Section outlines the items (for example, the entities, transactions, instruments, or events) to which the guidance in the Subtopic does or does not apply. In some cases, the Section may contain definitional or other text to frame the scope.

## General

842-20-15-1

# 20 Glossary

General Note:

The Master Glossary contains all terms identified as glossary terms throughout the Codification. Clicking on any term in the Master Glossary will display where the term is used. The Master Glossary may contain identical terms with different definitions, some of which may not be appropriate for a particular Subtopic. For any particular Subtopic, users should only use the glossary terms included in the particular Subtopic Glossary Section (Section 20).

#### Acquiree

The [business](/1943274/1790502/fasb-asc-publication/business#GUID-86560A46-A35F-4159-8419-E16EA66620DD) or [businesses](/1943274/1790502/fasb-asc-publication/business#GUID-86560A46-A35F-4159-8419-E16EA66620DD) that the [acquirer](/1943274/1786520/fasb-asc-publication/acquirer#GUID-CE40C6B5-D1F5-4022-8F08-4544E979D569) obtains control of in a [business combination](/1943274/1790556/fasb-asc-publication/business-combination#GUID-E12F04E9-BF64-44F4-A195-5F8EF2125960). This term also includes a nonprofit activity or business that a not-for-profit acquirer obtains control of in an [acquisition by a not-for-profit entity](/1943274/1786549/fasb-asc-publication/acquisition-by-a-not-for-profit-entity#GUID-D7BCBBC5-50F4-40A6-9B69-6A50FE87C96F).

The [business](/1943274/1790502/fasb-asc-publication/business#GUID-86560A46-A35F-4159-8419-E16EA66620DD) or [businesses](/1943274/1790502/fasb-asc-publication/business#GUID-86560A46-A35F-4159-8419-E16EA66620DD) that the [acquirer](/1943274/1786520/fasb-asc-publication/acquirer#GUID-CE40C6B5-D1F5-4022-8F08-4544E979D569) obtains control of in a [business combination](/1943274/1790556/fasb-asc-publication/business-combination#GUID-E12F04E9-BF64-44F4-A195-5F8EF2125960). This term also includes a nonprofit activity or business that a not-for-profit acquirer obtains control of in an [acquisition by a not-for-profit entity](/1943274/1786549/fasb-asc-publication/acquisition-by-a-not-for-profit-entity#GUID-D7BCBBC5-50F4-40A6-9B69-6A50FE87C96F).

#### Acquirer

The entity that obtains control of the [acquiree](/1943274/1786485/fasb-asc-publication/acquiree#GUID-B3908775-149B-468A-BE5D-951100675FF2). However, in a [business combination](/1943274/1790556/fasb-asc-publication/business-combination#GUID-E12F04E9-BF64-44F4-A195-5F8EF2125960) in which a [variable interest entity](/1943274/1831987/fasb-asc-publication/variable-interest-entity#GUID-4C738FC0-4491-40F6-B937-2CD26D4B362C) (VIE) is acquired, the primary beneficiary of that entity always is the acquirer.

#### Acquisition by a Not-for-Profit Entity

A transaction or other event in which a not-for-profit acquirer obtains control of one or more nonprofit activities or businesses and initially recognizes their assets and liabilities in the acquirer's financial statements. When applicable guidance in Topic 805 is applied by a [not-for-profit entity](/1943274/1814039/fasb-asc-publication/not-for-profit-entity#GUID-C6AB138F-85FC-4B54-A59E-E3F38ED6E0AD), the term [business combination](/1943274/1790556/fasb-asc-publication/business-combination#GUID-E12F04E9-BF64-44F4-A195-5F8EF2125960) has the same meaning as this term has for a for-profit entity. Likewise, a reference to business combinations in guidance that links to Topic 805 has the same meaning as a reference to acquisitions by not-for-profit entities.

A transaction or other event in which a not-for-profit acquirer obtains control of one or more nonprofit activities or businesses and initially recognizes their assets and liabilities in the acquirer's financial statements. When applicable guidance in Topic 805 is applied by a [not-for-profit entity](/1943274/1814039/fasb-asc-publication/not-for-profit-entity#GUID-C6AB138F-85FC-4B54-A59E-E3F38ED6E0AD), the term [business combination](/1943274/1790556/fasb-asc-publication/business-combination#GUID-E12F04E9-BF64-44F4-A195-5F8EF2125960) has the same meaning as this term has for a for-profit entity. Likewise, a reference to business combinations in guidance that links to Topic 805 has the same meaning as a reference to acquisitions by not-for-profit entities.

#### Change in Accounting Estimate

A change that has the effect of adjusting the carrying amount of an existing asset or liability or altering the subsequent accounting for existing or future assets or liabilities. A change in accounting estimate is a necessary consequence of the assessment, in conjunction with the periodic presentation of financial statements, of the present status and expected future benefits and obligations associated with assets and liabilities. Changes in accounting estimates result from new information. Examples of items for which estimates are necessary are uncollectible receivables, inventory obsolescence, service lives and salvage values of depreciable assets, and warranty obligations.

#### Contract

An agreement between two or more parties that creates enforceable rights and obligations.

#### Corporate Joint Venture

A corporation owned and operated by a small group of entities (the joint venturers) as a separate and specific business or project for the mutual benefit of the members of the group. A government may also be a member of the group. The purpose of a corporate joint venture frequently is to share risks and rewards in developing a new market, product or technology; to combine complementary technological knowledge; or to pool resources in developing production or other facilities. A corporate joint venture also usually provides an arrangement under which each joint venturer may participate, directly or indirectly, in the overall management of the joint venture. Joint venturers thus have an interest or relationship other than as passive investors. An entity that is a subsidiary of one of the joint venturers is not a corporate joint venture. The ownership of a corporate joint venture seldom changes, and its stock is usually not traded publicly. A noncontrolling interest held by public ownership, however, does not preclude a corporation from being a corporate joint venture.

A government may also be a member of the group. A corporate joint venture also usually provides an arrangement under which each joint venturer may participate, directly or indirectly, in the overall management of the joint venture. Joint venturers thus have an interest or relationship other than as passive investors. An entity that is a subsidiary of one of the joint venturers is not a corporate joint venture. The ownership of a corporate joint venture seldom changes, and its stock is usually not traded publicly. A noncontrolling interest held by public ownership, however, does not preclude a corporation from being a corporate joint venture.

For a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E), the discount rate for the lease is the rate implicit in the lease.

#### Joint Venture

An entity owned and operated by a small group of businesses (the joint venturers) as a separate and specific business or project for the mutual benefit of the members of the group. A government may also be a member of the group. The purpose of a joint venture frequently is to share risks and rewards in developing a new market, product, or technology; to combine complementary technological knowledge; or to pool resources in developing production or other facilities. A joint venture also usually provides an arrangement under which each joint venturer may participate, directly or indirectly, in the overall management of the joint venture. Joint venturers thus have an interest or relationship other than as passive investors. An entity that is a subsidiary of one of the joint venturers is not a joint venture. The ownership of a joint venture seldom changes, and its equity interests usually are not traded publicly. A minority public ownership, however, does not preclude an entity from being a joint venture. As distinguished from a [corporate joint venture](/1943274/1794896/fasb-asc-publication/corporate-joint-venture#GUID-664B8431-B291-4B79-8593-FAF7B2E74476), a joint venture is not limited to corporate entities.

A joint venture also usually provides an arrangement under which each joint venturer may participate, directly or indirectly, in the overall management of the joint venture. Joint venturers thus have an interest or relationship other than as passive investors. An entity that is a subsidiary of one of the joint venturers is not a joint venture. The ownership of a joint venture seldom changes, and its equity interests usually are not traded publicly. A minority public ownership, however, does not preclude an entity from being a joint venture. As distinguished from a [corporate joint venture](/1943274/1794896/fasb-asc-publication/corporate-joint-venture#GUID-664B8431-B291-4B79-8593-FAF7B2E74476), a joint venture is not limited to corporate entities.

#### Lease Modification

A change to the terms and conditions of a [contract](/1943274/1794186/fasb-asc-publication/contract#GUID-519A5B6D-FAE2-49CA-9E5C-23A65899BF9C) that results in a change in the scope of or the consideration for a [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease#GUID-315F0628-9CFF-471D-A2FE-5C70EA173444) (for example, a change to the terms and conditions of the contract that adds or terminates the right to use one or more underlying assets or extends or shortens the contractual lease term).

#### Lease Term

The noncancellable period for which a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee#GUID-A1861E90-70EA-4F9A-AE27-BAD47403E4D1) has the right to use an [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7), together with all of the following: 

  1. a

Periods covered by an option to extend the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease#GUID-315F0628-9CFF-471D-A2FE-5C70EA173444) if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option 

  2. b

Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option 

  3. c

Periods covered by an option to extend (or not to terminate) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E).

#### Market Participants

Buyers and sellers in the principal (or most advantageous) market for the asset or liability that have all of the following characteristics: 

  1. a

They are independent of each other, that is, they are not [related parties](/1943274/1821980/fasb-asc-publication/related-parties#GUID-4FA4CAEB-6F30-4E79-9197-C7641E586A35), although the price in a related-party transaction may be used as an input to a fair value measurement if the reporting entity has evidence that the transaction was entered into at market terms 

  2. b

They are knowledgeable, having a reasonable understanding about the asset or liability and the transaction using all available information, including information that might be obtained through due diligence efforts that are usual and customary 

  3. c

They are able to enter into a transaction for the asset or liability 

  4. d

They are willing to enter into a transaction for the asset or liability, that is, they are motivated but not forced or otherwise compelled to do so.

#### Monetary Liability

An obligation to pay a sum of money the amount of which is fixed or determinable without reference to future prices of specific goods and services. 

An obligation to pay a sum of money the amount of which is fixed or determinable without reference to future prices of specific goods and services. 

#### Not-for-Profit Entity

An entity that possesses the following characteristics, in varying degrees, that distinguish it from a business entity:

  1. a

Contributions of significant amounts of resources from resource providers who do not expect commensurate or proportionate pecuniary return 

  2. b

Operating purposes other than to provide goods or services at a profit 

  3. c

Absence of ownership interests like those of business entities. 




Entities that clearly fall outside this definition include the following:

  1. a

All investor-owned entities

  2. b

Entities that provide dividends, lower costs, or other economic benefits directly and proportionately to their owners, members, or participants, such as mutual insurance entities, credit unions, farm and rural electric cooperatives, and employee benefit plans.

#### Orderly Transaction

A transaction that assumes exposure to the market for a period before the measurement date to allow for marketing activities that are usual and customary for transactions involving such assets or liabilities; it is not a forced transaction (for example, a forced liquidation or distress sale).

#### Rate Implicit in the Lease

The rate of interest that, at a given date, causes the aggregate present value of (a) the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments#GUID-A53A70B0-DD03-46A7-B6DC-E23B170FD850)and (b) the amount that a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E) expects to derive from the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7) following the end of the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term#GUID-9A372489-2184-49AA-A968-84BD641E66CC)to equal the sum of (1) the [fair value](/1943274/1801222/fasb-asc-publication/fair-value#GUID-65D53DB7-38EE-4FD7-8576-D827BBA3660D) of the underlying asset minus any related investment tax credit retained and expected to be realized by the lessor and (2) any deferred [initial direct costs](/1943274/1806795/fasb-asc-publication/initial-direct-costs#GUID-E3F74B91-ACCB-4A89-BEB9-EE480715B20F) of the lessor. However, if the rate determined in accordance with the preceding sentence is less than zero, a rate implicit in the lease of zero shall be used.

#### Related Parties

Related parties include: 

  1. a

Affiliates of the entity 

  2. b

Entities for which investments in their equity securities would be required, absent the election of the fair value option under the [Fair Value Option Subsection](/1943274/2147482834/fasb-asc-publication/scope#GUID-B35A593E-E390-4CB6-B196-DF6A52889624) of Section 825-10-15, to be accounted for by the equity method by the investing entity 

  3. c

Trusts for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of management 

  4. d

Principal owners of the entity and members of their immediate families 

  5. e

Management of the entity and members of their immediate families 

  6. f

Other parties with which the entity may deal if one party controls or can significantly influence the management or operating policies of the other to an extent that one of the transacting parties might be prevented from fully pursuing its own separate interests 

  7. g

Other parties that can significantly influence the management or operating policies of the transacting parties or that have an ownership interest in one of the transacting parties and can significantly influence the other to an extent that one or more of the transacting parties might be prevented from fully pursuing its own separate interests.

Payments made by a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee#GUID-A1861E90-70EA-4F9A-AE27-BAD47403E4D1) to a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E) for the right to use an [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7) that vary because of changes in facts or circumstances occurring after the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date-#GUID-960D811B-9F70-4B26-85C6-FADBA027689A), other than the passage of time. 

Payments made by a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee#GUID-A1861E90-70EA-4F9A-AE27-BAD47403E4D1) to a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E) for the right to use an [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7) that vary because of changes in facts or circumstances occurring after the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date-#GUID-960D811B-9F70-4B26-85C6-FADBA027689A), other than the passage of time.

# 25 Recognition

General Note:

The Recognition Section provides guidance on the required criteria, timing, and location (within the financial statements) for recording a particular item in the financial statements. Disclosure is not recognition.

## General

842-20-25-1

At the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall recognize a [right-of-use asset](/1943274/1824127/fasb-asc-publication/right-of-use-asset "An asset that represents a lessee's right to use an underlying asset for the lease term.") and a [lease liability](/1943274/1808833/fasb-asc-publication/lease-liability "A lessee's obligation to make the lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis.").

842-20-25-1

At the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall recognize a [right-of-use asset](/1943274/1824127/fasb-asc-publication/right-of-use-asset "An asset that represents a lessee's right to use an underlying asset for the lease term.") and a [lease liability](/1943274/1808833/fasb-asc-publication/lease-liability "A lessee's obligation to make the lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis.").

### > Short-Term Leases

842-20-25-2

As an accounting policy, a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") may elect not to apply the recognition requirements in this Subtopic to [short-term leases](/1943274/1826141/fasb-asc-publication/short-term-lease "A lease that, at the commencement date, has a lease term of 12 months or less and does not include an option to purchase the underlying asset that the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise."). Instead, a lessee may recognize the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") in profit or loss on a straight-line basis over the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor.") and [variable lease payments](/1943274/1832014/fasb-asc-publication/variable-lease-payments "Payments made by a lessee to a lessor for the right to use an underlying asset that vary because of changes in facts or circumstances occurring after the commencement date, other than the passage of time.") in the period in which the obligation for those payments is incurred (consistent with paragraphs 

[842-20-55-1 through 55-2](/1943274/2147479589/fasb-asc-publication/implementation#SL77918757-209971__SL77918758-209971)

). The accounting policy election for short-term leases shall be made by class of [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") to which the right of use relates.

842-20-25-2

As an accounting policy, a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") may elect not to apply the recognition requirements in this Subtopic to [short-term leases](/1943274/1826141/fasb-asc-publication/short-term-lease "A lease that, at the commencement date, has a lease term of 12 months or less and does not include an option to purchase the underlying asset that the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise."). Instead, a lessee may recognize the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") in profit or loss on a straight-line basis over the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor.") and [variable lease payments](/1943274/1832014/fasb-asc-publication/variable-lease-payments "Payments made by a lessee to a lessor for the right to use an underlying asset that vary because of changes in facts or circumstances occurring after the commencement date, other than the passage of time.") in the period in which the obligation for those payments is incurred (consistent with paragraphs 

[842-20-55-1 through 55-2](/1943274/2147479589/fasb-asc-publication/implementation#SL77918757-209971__SL77918758-209971)

). The accounting policy election for short-term leases shall be made by class of [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") to which the right of use relates.

842-20-25-3

If the lease term or the assessment of a lessee option to purchase the underlying asset changes such that, after the change, the remaining lease term extends more than 12 months from the end of the previously determined lease term or the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise its option to purchase the underlying asset, the lease no longer meets the definition of a short-term lease and the lessee shall apply the remainder of the guidance in this Topic as if the date of the change in circumstances is the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date.").

842-20-25-3

If the lease term or the assessment of a lessee option to purchase the underlying asset changes such that, after the change, the remaining lease term extends more than 12 months from the end of the previously determined lease term or the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise its option to purchase the underlying asset, the lease no longer meets the definition of a short-term lease and the lessee shall apply the remainder of the guidance in this Topic as if the date of the change in circumstances is the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date.").

### > Finance Leases

842-20-25-5

After the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall recognize in profit or loss, unless the costs are included in the carrying amount of another asset in accordance with other Topics:

  1. a

Amortization of the [right-of-use asset](/1943274/1824127/fasb-asc-publication/right-of-use-asset "An asset that represents a lessee's right to use an underlying asset for the lease term.") and interest on the [lease liability](/1943274/1808833/fasb-asc-publication/lease-liability "A lessee's obligation to make the lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis.")

  2. b

[Variable lease payments](/1943274/1832014/fasb-asc-publication/variable-lease-payments "Payments made by a lessee to a lessor for the right to use an underlying asset that vary because of changes in facts or circumstances occurring after the commencement date, other than the passage of time.") not included in the lease liability in the period in which the obligation for those payments is incurred (see paragraphs 

[842-20-55-1 through 55-2](/1943274/2147479589/fasb-asc-publication/implementation#SL77918757-209971__SL77918758-209971)

)

  3. c

Any impairment of the right-of-use asset determined in accordance with paragraph [842-20-35-9](/1943274/2147479165/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77918539-209967__SL77918540-209967).




842-20-25-5

After the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall recognize in profit or loss, unless the costs are included in the carrying amount of another asset in accordance with other Topics:

  1. a

Amortization of the [right-of-use asset](/1943274/1824127/fasb-asc-publication/right-of-use-asset "An asset that represents a lessee's right to use an underlying asset for the lease term.") and interest on the [lease liability](/1943274/1808833/fasb-asc-publication/lease-liability "A lessee's obligation to make the lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis.")

  2. b

[Variable lease payments](/1943274/1832014/fasb-asc-publication/variable-lease-payments "Payments made by a lessee to a lessor for the right to use an underlying asset that vary because of changes in facts or circumstances occurring after the commencement date, other than the passage of time.") not included in the lease liability in the period in which the obligation for those payments is incurred (see paragraphs 

[842-20-55-1 through 55-2](/1943274/2147479589/fasb-asc-publication/implementation#SL77918757-209971__SL77918758-209971)

)

  3. c

Any impairment of the right-of-use asset determined in accordance with paragraph [842-20-35-9](/1943274/2147479165/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77918539-209967__SL77918540-209967).




### > Operating Leases

842-20-25-6

After the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall recognize all of the following in profit or loss, unless the costs are included in the carrying amount of another asset in accordance with other Topics:

  1. a

A single lease cost, calculated so that the remaining cost of the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") (as described in paragraph [842-20-25-8](/1943274/2147479365/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77918430-209957__SL77918440-209957)) is allocated over the remaining [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor.") on a straight-line basis unless another systematic and rational basis is more representative of the pattern in which benefit is expected to be derived from the right to use the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") (see paragraph [842-20-55-3](/1943274/2147479589/fasb-asc-publication/implementation#SL77918762-209971__SL77918763-209971)), unless the [right-of-use asset](/1943274/1824127/fasb-asc-publication/right-of-use-asset "An asset that represents a lessee's right to use an underlying asset for the lease term.") has been impaired in accordance with paragraph [842-20-35-9](/1943274/2147479165/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77918539-209967__SL77918540-209967), in which case the single lease cost is calculated in accordance with paragraph [842-20-25-7](/1943274/2147479365/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77918430-209957__SL77918436-209957)

  2. b

[Variable lease payments](/1943274/1832014/fasb-asc-publication/variable-lease-payments "Payments made by a lessee to a lessor for the right to use an underlying asset that vary because of changes in facts or circumstances occurring after the commencement date, other than the passage of time.") not included in the [lease liability](/1943274/1808833/fasb-asc-publication/lease-liability "A lessee's obligation to make the lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis.") in the period in which the obligation for those payments is incurred (see paragraphs 

[842-20-55-1 through 55-2](/1943274/2147479589/fasb-asc-publication/implementation#SL77918757-209971__SL77918758-209971)

)

  3. c

Any impairment of the right-of-use asset determined in accordance with paragraph [842-20-35-9](/1943274/2147479165/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77918539-209967__SL77918540-209967).




842-20-25-6

After the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall recognize all of the following in profit or loss, unless the costs are included in the carrying amount of another asset in accordance with other Topics:

  1. a

A single lease cost, calculated so that the remaining cost of the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") (as described in paragraph [842-20-25-8](/1943274/2147479365/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77918430-209957__SL77918440-209957)) is allocated over the remaining [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor.") on a straight-line basis unless another systematic and rational basis is more representative of the pattern in which benefit is expected to be derived from the right to use the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") (see paragraph [842-20-55-3](/1943274/2147479589/fasb-asc-publication/implementation#SL77918762-209971__SL77918763-209971)), unless the [right-of-use asset](/1943274/1824127/fasb-asc-publication/right-of-use-asset "An asset that represents a lessee's right to use an underlying asset for the lease term.") has been impaired in accordance with paragraph [842-20-35-9](/1943274/2147479165/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77918539-209967__SL77918540-209967), in which case the single lease cost is calculated in accordance with paragraph [842-20-25-7](/1943274/2147479365/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77918430-209957__SL77918436-209957)

  2. b

[Variable lease payments](/1943274/1832014/fasb-asc-publication/variable-lease-payments "Payments made by a lessee to a lessor for the right to use an underlying asset that vary because of changes in facts or circumstances occurring after the commencement date, other than the passage of time.") not included in the [lease liability](/1943274/1808833/fasb-asc-publication/lease-liability "A lessee's obligation to make the lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis.") in the period in which the obligation for those payments is incurred (see paragraphs 

[842-20-55-1 through 55-2](/1943274/2147479589/fasb-asc-publication/implementation#SL77918757-209971__SL77918758-209971)

)

  3. c

Any impairment of the right-of-use asset determined in accordance with paragraph [842-20-35-9](/1943274/2147479165/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77918539-209967__SL77918540-209967).




842-20-25-7

After a right-of-use asset has been impaired in accordance with paragraph [842-20-35-9](/1943274/2147479165/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77918539-209967__SL77918540-209967), the single lease cost described in paragraph [842-20-25-6(a)](/1943274/2147479365/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77918430-209957__SL77918431-209957) shall be calculated as the sum of the following:

  1. a

Amortization of the remaining balance of the right-of-use asset after the impairment on a straight-line basis, unless another systematic basis is more representative of the pattern in which the lessee expects to consume the remaining economic benefits from its right to use the underlying asset

  2. b

Accretion of the lease liability, determined for each remaining period during the lease term as the amount that produces a constant periodic discount rate on the remaining balance of the liability.




842-20-25-7

After a right-of-use asset has been impaired in accordance with paragraph [842-20-35-9](/1943274/2147479165/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77918539-209967__SL77918540-209967), the single lease cost described in paragraph [842-20-25-6(a)](/1943274/2147479365/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77918430-209957__SL77918431-209957) shall be calculated as the sum of the following:

  1. a

Amortization of the remaining balance of the right-of-use asset after the impairment on a straight-line basis, unless another systematic basis is more representative of the pattern in which the lessee expects to consume the remaining economic benefits from its right to use the underlying asset

  2. b

Accretion of the lease liability, determined for each remaining period during the lease term as the amount that produces a constant periodic discount rate on the remaining balance of the liability.

Throughout the lease term, the remaining cost of an [operating lease](/1943274/1814638/fasb-asc-publication/operating-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, any lease other than a finance lease. From the perspective of a lessor, any lease other than a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease.") for which the right-of-use asset has not been impaired consists of the following:

  1. a

The total [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") (including those paid and those not yet paid), reflecting any adjustment to that total amount resulting from either a remeasurement in accordance with paragraphs 

[842-10-35-4 through 35-5](/1943274/2147479894/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77916707-209966__SL77916708-209966)

or a [lease modification](/1943274/1808859/fasb-asc-publication/lease-modification "A change to the terms and conditions of a contract that results in a change in the scope of or the consideration for a lease \(for example, a change to the terms and conditions of the contract that adds or terminates the right to use one or more underlying assets or extends or shortens the contractual lease term\)."); plus

  2. b

The total [initial direct costs](/1943274/1806795/fasb-asc-publication/initial-direct-costs "Incremental costs of a lease that would not have been incurred if the lease had not been obtained.") attributable to the lease; minus

  3. c

The periodic lease cost recognized in prior periods.




842-20-25-8

Throughout the lease term, the remaining cost of an [operating lease](/1943274/1814638/fasb-asc-publication/operating-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, any lease other than a finance lease. From the perspective of a lessor, any lease other than a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease.") for which the right-of-use asset has not been impaired consists of the following:

  1. a

The total [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") (including those paid and those not yet paid), reflecting any adjustment to that total amount resulting from either a remeasurement in accordance with paragraphs 

[842-10-35-4 through 35-5](/1943274/2147479894/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77916707-209966__SL77916708-209966)

or a [lease modification](/1943274/1808859/fasb-asc-publication/lease-modification "A change to the terms and conditions of a contract that results in a change in the scope of or the consideration for a lease \(for example, a change to the terms and conditions of the contract that adds or terminates the right to use one or more underlying assets or extends or shortens the contractual lease term\)."); plus

  2. b

The total [initial direct costs](/1943274/1806795/fasb-asc-publication/initial-direct-costs "Incremental costs of a lease that would not have been incurred if the lease had not been obtained.") attributable to the lease; minus

  3. c

The periodic lease cost recognized in prior periods.

# 30 Initial Measurement

General Note:

The Initial Measurement Section provides guidance on the criteria and amounts used to measure a particular item at the date of initial recognition.

## General

842-20-30-1

At the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall measure both of the following:

  1. a

The [lease liability](/1943274/1808833/fasb-asc-publication/lease-liability "A lessee's obligation to make the lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis.") at the present value of the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") not yet paid, discounted using the [discount rate for the lease](/1943274/1798211/fasb-asc-publication/discount-rate-for-the-lease "For a lessee, the discount rate for the lease is the rate implicit in the lease unless that rate cannot be readily determined. In that case, the lessee is required to use its incremental borrowing rate. For a lessor, the discount rate for the lease is the rate implicit in the lease.") at lease commencement (as described in paragraphs 

[842-20-30-2 through 30-4](/1943274/2147479269/fasb-asc-publication/initial-measurement#SL77918475-209962__SL77918476-209962)

) 

  2. b

However, if the rate determined in accordance with the preceding sentence is less than zero, a rate implicit in the lease of zero shall be used.") whenever that rate is readily determinable. ).

# 35 Subsequent Measurement

General Note:

The Subsequent Measurement Section provides guidance on an entity's subsequent measurement and subsequent recognition of an item. Situations that may result in subsequent changes to carrying amount include impairment, credit losses, fair value adjustments, depreciation and amortization, and so forth.

## General

842-20-35-1

After the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), for a [finance lease](/1943274/1801775/fasb-asc-publication/finance-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2."), a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall measure both of the following:

  1. a

The [lease liability](/1943274/1808833/fasb-asc-publication/lease-liability "A lessee's obligation to make the lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis.") by increasing the carrying amount to reflect interest on the lease liability and reducing the carrying amount to reflect the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") made during the period. The lessee shall determine the interest on the lease liability in each period during the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor.") as the amount that produces a constant periodic discount rate on the remaining balance of the liability, taking into consideration the reassessment requirements in paragraphs 

[842-10-35-1 through 35-5](/1943274/2147479894/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77916696-209966__SL77916697-209966)

.

  2. b

The [right-of-use asset](/1943274/1824127/fasb-asc-publication/right-of-use-asset "An asset that represents a lessee's right to use an underlying asset for the lease term.") at cost less any accumulated amortization and any accumulated impairment losses, taking into consideration the reassessment requirements in paragraphs 

[842-10-35-1 through 35-5](/1943274/2147479894/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77916696-209966__SL77916697-209966)

.




842-20-35-1

After the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), for a [finance lease](/1943274/1801775/fasb-asc-publication/finance-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2."), a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall measure both of the following:

  1. a

The [lease liability](/1943274/1808833/fasb-asc-publication/lease-liability "A lessee's obligation to make the lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis.") by increasing the carrying amount to reflect interest on the lease liability and reducing the carrying amount to reflect the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") made during the period. The lessee shall determine the interest on the lease liability in each period during the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor.") as the amount that produces a constant periodic discount rate on the remaining balance of the liability, taking into consideration the reassessment requirements in paragraphs 

[842-10-35-1 through 35-5](/1943274/2147479894/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77916696-209966__SL77916697-209966)

.

  2. b

The [right-of-use asset](/1943274/1824127/fasb-asc-publication/right-of-use-asset "An asset that represents a lessee's right to use an underlying asset for the lease term.") at cost less any accumulated amortization and any accumulated impairment losses, taking into consideration the reassessment requirements in paragraphs 

[842-10-35-1 through 35-5](/1943274/2147479894/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77916696-209966__SL77916697-209966)

.




842-20-35-2

A lessee shall recognize amortization of the right-of-use asset and interest on the lease liability for a finance lease in accordance with paragraph [842-20-25-5](/1943274/2147479365/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77918424-209957__SL77918425-209957).

842-20-35-2

After the commencement date, for an [operating lease](/1943274/1814638/fasb-asc-publication/operating-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, any lease other than a finance lease. From the perspective of a lessor, any lease other than a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease."), a lessee shall measure both of the following:

  1. a

The lease liability at the present value of the lease payments not yet paid discounted using the [discount rate for the lease](/1943274/1798211/fasb-asc-publication/discount-rate-for-the-lease "For a lessee, the discount rate for the lease is the rate implicit in the lease unless that rate cannot be readily determined. In that case, the lessee is required to use its incremental borrowing rate. For a lessor, the discount rate for the lease is the rate implicit in the lease.") established at the commencement date (unless the rate has been updated after the commencement date in accordance with paragraph [842-20-35-5](/1943274/2147479165/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77918524-209967__SL77918527-209967), in which case that updated rate shall be used)

  2. b

The right-of-use asset at the amount of the lease liability, adjusted for the following, unless the right-of-use asset has been previously impaired, in which case the right-of-use asset is measured in accordance with paragraph [842-20-35-10](/1943274/2147479165/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77918539-209967__SL77918542-209967) after the impairment:

     1. 1

Prepaid or accrued lease payments

     2. 2

The remaining balance of any lease incentives received, which is the amount of the gross lease incentives received net of amounts recognized previously as part of the single lease cost described in paragraph [842-20-25-6(a)](/1943274/2147479365/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77918430-209957__SL77918431-209957)

     3. 3

Unamortized [initial direct costs](/1943274/1806795/fasb-asc-publication/initial-direct-costs "Incremental costs of a lease that would not have been incurred if the lease had not been obtained.")

     4. 4

Impairment of the right-of-use asset.

After the commencement date, for an [operating lease](/1943274/1814638/fasb-asc-publication/operating-lease "From the perspective of a lessee, any lease other than a finance lease.   2. b

The right-of-use asset at the amount of the lease liability, adjusted for the following, unless the right-of-use asset has been previously impaired, in which case the right-of-use asset is measured in accordance with paragraph [842-20-35-10](/1943274/2147479165/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77918539-209967__SL77918542-209967) after the impairment:

     1. 1

     3. 3

Unamortized [initial direct costs](/1943274/1806795/fasb-asc-publication/initial-direct-costs "Incremental costs of a lease that would not have been incurred if the lease had not been obtained.")

### > Remeasurement of the Lease Liability

842-20-35-4

After the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall remeasure the [lease liability](/1943274/1808833/fasb-asc-publication/lease-liability "A lessee's obligation to make the lease payments arising from a lease, measured on a discounted basis.") to reflect changes to the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") as described in paragraphs 

[842-10-35-4 through 35-5](/1943274/2147479894/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77916707-209966__SL77916708-209966)

. A lessee shall recognize the amount of the remeasurement of the lease liability as an adjustment to the [right-of-use asset](/1943274/1824127/fasb-asc-publication/right-of-use-asset "An asset that represents a lessee's right to use an underlying asset for the lease term."). However, if the carrying amount of the right-of-use asset is reduced to zero, a lessee shall recognize any remaining amount of the remeasurement in profit or loss.

842-20-35-4

[842-10-35-4 through 35-5](/1943274/2147479894/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77916707-209966__SL77916708-209966)

. However, if the carrying amount of the right-of-use asset is reduced to zero, a lessee shall recognize any remaining amount of the remeasurement in profit or loss.
