#### Lease Receivable

A [lessor's](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E) right to receive [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments#GUID-A53A70B0-DD03-46A7-B6DC-E23B170FD850) arising from a [sales-type lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease#GUID-7A620090-BA69-437B-A5F4-836B9EFC79EE) or a [direct financing lease](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease#GUID-C753F086-DB13-4255-BD5E-7ACF0C59A93A) plus any amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term#GUID-9A372489-2184-49AA-A968-84BD641E66CC) to the extent that it is guaranteed by the [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee#GUID-A1861E90-70EA-4F9A-AE27-BAD47403E4D1) or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis. 

A [lessor's](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E) right to receive [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments#GUID-A53A70B0-DD03-46A7-B6DC-E23B170FD850) arising from a [sales-type lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease#GUID-7A620090-BA69-437B-A5F4-836B9EFC79EE) or a [direct financing lease](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease#GUID-C753F086-DB13-4255-BD5E-7ACF0C59A93A) plus any amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term#GUID-9A372489-2184-49AA-A968-84BD641E66CC) to the extent that it is guaranteed by the [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee#GUID-A1861E90-70EA-4F9A-AE27-BAD47403E4D1) or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis. 

#### Lease Term

The noncancellable period for which a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee#GUID-A1861E90-70EA-4F9A-AE27-BAD47403E4D1) has the right to use an [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7), together with all of the following: 

  1. a

Periods covered by an option to extend the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease#GUID-315F0628-9CFF-471D-A2FE-5C70EA173444) if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option 

  2. b

Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option 

  3. c

Periods covered by an option to extend (or not to terminate) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E). 




The noncancellable period for which a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee#GUID-A1861E90-70EA-4F9A-AE27-BAD47403E4D1) has the right to use an [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7), together with all of the following: 

  1. a

Periods covered by an option to extend the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease#GUID-315F0628-9CFF-471D-A2FE-5C70EA173444) if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option 

  2. b

Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option 

  3. c

Periods covered by an option to extend (or not to terminate) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E). 




#### Lessee

An entity that enters into a [contract](/1943274/1794186/fasb-asc-publication/contract#GUID-519A5B6D-FAE2-49CA-9E5C-23A65899BF9C) to obtain the right to use an [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.

An entity that enters into a [contract](/1943274/1794186/fasb-asc-publication/contract#GUID-519A5B6D-FAE2-49CA-9E5C-23A65899BF9C) to obtain the right to use an [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.

#### Lessor

An entity that enters into a [contract](/1943274/1794186/fasb-asc-publication/contract#GUID-519A5B6D-FAE2-49CA-9E5C-23A65899BF9C) to provide the right to use an [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7) for a period of time in exchange for consideration. 

An entity that enters into a [contract](/1943274/1794186/fasb-asc-publication/contract#GUID-519A5B6D-FAE2-49CA-9E5C-23A65899BF9C) to provide the right to use an [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7) for a period of time in exchange for consideration. 

#### Market Participants

Buyers and sellers in the principal (or most advantageous) market for the asset or liability that have all of the following characteristics: 

  1. a

They are independent of each other, that is, they are not [related parties](/1943274/1821980/fasb-asc-publication/related-parties#GUID-4FA4CAEB-6F30-4E79-9197-C7641E586A35), although the price in a related-party transaction may be used as an input to a fair value measurement if the reporting entity has evidence that the transaction was entered into at market terms 

  2. b

They are knowledgeable, having a reasonable understanding about the asset or liability and the transaction using all available information, including information that might be obtained through due diligence efforts that are usual and customary 

  3. c

They are able to enter into a transaction for the asset or liability 

  4. d

They are willing to enter into a transaction for the asset or liability, that is, they are motivated but not forced or otherwise compelled to do so. 




Buyers and sellers in the principal (or most advantageous) market for the asset or liability that have all of the following characteristics: 

  1. a

They are independent of each other, that is, they are not [related parties](/1943274/1821980/fasb-asc-publication/related-parties#GUID-4FA4CAEB-6F30-4E79-9197-C7641E586A35), although the price in a related-party transaction may be used as an input to a fair value measurement if the reporting entity has evidence that the transaction was entered into at market terms 

  2. b

They are knowledgeable, having a reasonable understanding about the asset or liability and the transaction using all available information, including information that might be obtained through due diligence efforts that are usual and customary 

  3. c

They are able to enter into a transaction for the asset or liability 

  4. d

They are willing to enter into a transaction for the asset or liability, that is, they are motivated but not forced or otherwise compelled to do so. 




#### Net Investment in the Lease

For a [sales-type lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease#GUID-7A620090-BA69-437B-A5F4-836B9EFC79EE), the sum of the [lease receivable](/1943274/1808911/fasb-asc-publication/lease-receivable#GUID-7623BED8-529D-4E43-AB88-1CD5F15E35B7) and the [unguaranteed residual asset](/1943274/1830843/fasb-asc-publication/unguaranteed-residual-asset#GUID-B227F1F2-7672-4BBE-896E-EC41F5753E49). 

For a [direct financing lease](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease#GUID-C753F086-DB13-4255-BD5E-7ACF0C59A93A), the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit. 

For a [sales-type lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease#GUID-7A620090-BA69-437B-A5F4-836B9EFC79EE), the sum of the [lease receivable](/1943274/1808911/fasb-asc-publication/lease-receivable#GUID-7623BED8-529D-4E43-AB88-1CD5F15E35B7) and the [unguaranteed residual asset](/1943274/1830843/fasb-asc-publication/unguaranteed-residual-asset#GUID-B227F1F2-7672-4BBE-896E-EC41F5753E49). 

For a [direct financing lease](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease#GUID-C753F086-DB13-4255-BD5E-7ACF0C59A93A), the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit. 

#### Operating Lease

From the perspective of a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee#GUID-A1861E90-70EA-4F9A-AE27-BAD47403E4D1), any [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease#GUID-315F0628-9CFF-471D-A2FE-5C70EA173444) other than a [finance lease](/1943274/1801775/fasb-asc-publication/finance-lease#GUID-E48E5D36-1A16-4880-8D9F-E0D3E569B2EB). 

From the perspective of a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E), any lease other than a [sales-type lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease#GUID-7A620090-BA69-437B-A5F4-836B9EFC79EE) or a [direct financing lease](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease#GUID-C753F086-DB13-4255-BD5E-7ACF0C59A93A).

#### Orderly Transaction

A transaction that assumes exposure to the market for a period before the measurement date to allow for marketing activities that are usual and customary for transactions involving such assets or liabilities; it is not a forced transaction (for example, a forced liquidation or distress sale). 

A transaction that assumes exposure to the market for a period before the measurement date to allow for marketing activities that are usual and customary for transactions involving such assets or liabilities; it is not a forced transaction (for example, a forced liquidation or distress sale). 

#### Probable

The future event or events are likely to occur. 

The future event or events are likely to occur. 

#### Rate Implicit in the Lease

The rate of interest that, at a given date, causes the aggregate present value of (a) the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments#GUID-A53A70B0-DD03-46A7-B6DC-E23B170FD850)and (b) the amount that a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E) expects to derive from the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7) following the end of the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term#GUID-9A372489-2184-49AA-A968-84BD641E66CC)to equal the sum of (1) the [fair value](/1943274/1801222/fasb-asc-publication/fair-value#GUID-65D53DB7-38EE-4FD7-8576-D827BBA3660D) of the underlying asset minus any related investment tax credit retained and expected to be realized by the lessor and (2) any deferred [initial direct costs](/1943274/1806795/fasb-asc-publication/initial-direct-costs#GUID-E3F74B91-ACCB-4A89-BEB9-EE480715B20F) of the lessor. However, if the rate determined in accordance with the preceding sentence is less than zero, a rate implicit in the lease of zero shall be used.

#### Related Parties

Related parties include: 

  1. a

Affiliates of the entity 

  2. b

Entities for which investments in their equity securities would be required, absent the election of the fair value option under the [Fair Value Option Subsection](/1943274/2147482834/fasb-asc-publication/scope#GUID-B35A593E-E390-4CB6-B196-DF6A52889624) of Section 825-10-15, to be accounted for by the equity method by the investing entity 

  3. c

Trusts for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of management 

  4. d

Principal owners of the entity and members of their immediate families 

  5. e

Management of the entity and members of their immediate families 

  6. f

Other parties with which the entity may deal if one party controls or can significantly influence the management or operating policies of the other to an extent that one of the transacting parties might be prevented from fully pursuing its own separate interests 

  7. g

Other parties that can significantly influence the management or operating policies of the transacting parties or that have an ownership interest in one of the transacting parties and can significantly influence the other to an extent that one or more of the transacting parties might be prevented from fully pursuing its own separate interests.

#### Underlying Asset

An asset that is the subject of a [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease#GUID-315F0628-9CFF-471D-A2FE-5C70EA173444) for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee#GUID-A1861E90-70EA-4F9A-AE27-BAD47403E4D1). The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.

The amount that a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor#GUID-5CB0030C-61B0-4FE0-B885-6BE419E48A9E) expects to derive from the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset#GUID-46FF7065-6EEF-4C3B-A6F3-646CED022CE7) following the end of the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term#GUID-9A372489-2184-49AA-A968-84BD641E66CC) that is not guaranteed by the [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee#GUID-A1861E90-70EA-4F9A-AE27-BAD47403E4D1) or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.

# 25 Recognition

General Note:

The Recognition Section provides guidance on the required criteria, timing, and location (within the financial statements) for recording a particular item in the financial statements. Disclosure is not recognition.

## General

### > Sales-Type Leases

842-30-25-1

At the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall recognize each of the following and derecognize the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") in accordance with paragraph [842-30-40-1](/1943274/2147479066/fasb-asc-publication/derecognition#SL77919272-209976__SL77919273-209976):

  1. a

A [net investment in the lease](/1943274/1813053/fasb-asc-publication/net-investment-in-the-lease "For a sales-type lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset. For a direct financing lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit."), measured in accordance with paragraph [842-30-30-1](/1943274/2147479244/fasb-asc-publication/initial-measurement#SL77919205-209963__SL77919206-209963)

  2. b

[Selling profit or selling loss](/1943274/1825339/fasb-asc-publication/selling-profit-or-selling-loss "At the commencement date, selling profit or selling loss equals: The fair value of the underlying asset or the sum of \(1\) the lease receivable and \(2\) any lease payments prepaid by the lessee, if lower; minus The carrying amount of the underlying asset net of any unguaranteed residual asset; minus Any deferred initial direct costs of the lessor.") arising from the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.")

  3. c

[Initial direct costs](/1943274/1806795/fasb-asc-publication/initial-direct-costs "Incremental costs of a lease that would not have been incurred if the lease had not been obtained.") as an expense if, at the commencement date, the [fair value](/1943274/1801222/fasb-asc-publication/fair-value "The price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date.") of the underlying asset is different from its carrying amount. If the fair value of the underlying asset equals its carrying amount, initial direct costs (see paragraphs 

[842-10-30-9 through 30-10](/1943274/2147479924/fasb-asc-publication/initial-measurement#SL77916654-209961__SL77916655-209961)

) are deferred at the commencement date and included in the measurement of the net investment in the lease. The [rate implicit in the lease](/1943274/1821062/fasb-asc-publication/rate-implicit-in-the-lease "The rate of interest that, at a given date, causes the aggregate present value of \(a\) the lease paymentsand \(b\) the amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease termto equal the sum of \(1\) the fair value of the underlying asset minus any related investment tax credit retained and expected to be realized by the lessor and \(2\) any deferred initial direct costs of the lessor. However, if the rate determined in accordance with the preceding sentence is less than zero, a rate implicit in the lease of zero shall be used.") is defined in such a way that those initial direct costs eligible for deferral are included automatically in the net investment in the lease; there is no need to add them separately.




842-30-25-1

At the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall recognize each of the following and derecognize the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") in accordance with paragraph [842-30-40-1](/1943274/2147479066/fasb-asc-publication/derecognition#SL77919272-209976__SL77919273-209976):

  1. a

A [net investment in the lease](/1943274/1813053/fasb-asc-publication/net-investment-in-the-lease "For a sales-type lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset. For a direct financing lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit."), measured in accordance with paragraph [842-30-30-1](/1943274/2147479244/fasb-asc-publication/initial-measurement#SL77919205-209963__SL77919206-209963)

  2. b

[Selling profit or selling loss](/1943274/1825339/fasb-asc-publication/selling-profit-or-selling-loss "At the commencement date, selling profit or selling loss equals: The fair value of the underlying asset or the sum of \(1\) the lease receivable and \(2\) any lease payments prepaid by the lessee, if lower; minus The carrying amount of the underlying asset net of any unguaranteed residual asset; minus Any deferred initial direct costs of the lessor.") arising from the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.")

  3. c

[Initial direct costs](/1943274/1806795/fasb-asc-publication/initial-direct-costs "Incremental costs of a lease that would not have been incurred if the lease had not been obtained.") as an expense if, at the commencement date, the [fair value](/1943274/1801222/fasb-asc-publication/fair-value "The price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date.") of the underlying asset is different from its carrying amount. If the fair value of the underlying asset equals its carrying amount, initial direct costs (see paragraphs 

[842-10-30-9 through 30-10](/1943274/2147479924/fasb-asc-publication/initial-measurement#SL77916654-209961__SL77916655-209961)

) are deferred at the commencement date and included in the measurement of the net investment in the lease. The [rate implicit in the lease](/1943274/1821062/fasb-asc-publication/rate-implicit-in-the-lease "The rate of interest that, at a given date, causes the aggregate present value of \(a\) the lease paymentsand \(b\) the amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease termto equal the sum of \(1\) the fair value of the underlying asset minus any related investment tax credit retained and expected to be realized by the lessor and \(2\) any deferred initial direct costs of the lessor. However, if the rate determined in accordance with the preceding sentence is less than zero, a rate implicit in the lease of zero shall be used.") is defined in such a way that those initial direct costs eligible for deferral are included automatically in the net investment in the lease; there is no need to add them separately.




842-30-25-2

After the commencement date, a lessor shall recognize all of the following:

  1. a

Interest income on the net investment in the lease, measured in accordance with paragraph [842-30-35-1(a)](/1943274/2147479139/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77919229-209968__SL77930328-209968)

  2. b

[Variable lease payments](/1943274/1832014/fasb-asc-publication/variable-lease-payments "Payments made by a lessee to a lessor for the right to use an underlying asset that vary because of changes in facts or circumstances occurring after the commencement date, other than the passage of time.") that are not included in the net investment in the lease as income in profit or loss in the period when the changes in facts and circumstances on which the variable lease payments are based occur

  3. c

Credit losses on the net investment in the lease (as described in paragraph [842-30-35-3](/1943274/2147479139/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77919234-209968__SL77930333-209968)).

  2. b

[Variable lease payments](/1943274/1832014/fasb-asc-publication/variable-lease-payments "Payments made by a lessee to a lessor for the right to use an underlying asset that vary because of changes in facts or circumstances occurring after the commencement date, other than the passage of time.") that are not included in the net investment in the lease as income in profit or loss in the period when the changes in facts and circumstances on which the variable lease payments are based occur

  3. c

Credit losses on the net investment in the lease (as described in paragraph [842-30-35-3](/1943274/2147479139/fasb-asc-publication/subsequent-measurement#SL77919234-209968__SL77930333-209968)).




842-30-25-3

The guidance in paragraphs 

[842-30-25-1 through 25-2](/1943274/2147479341/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77919095-209958__SL77919096-209958)

notwithstanding, if collectibility of the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor."), plus any amount necessary to satisfy a [residual value guarantee](/1943274/1823121/fasb-asc-publication/residual-value-guarantee "A guarantee made to a lessor that the value of an underlying asset returned to the lessor at the end of a lease will be at least a specified amount.") provided by the [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration."), is not [probable](/1943274/1818955/fasb-asc-publication/probable "The future event or events are likely to occur.") at the commencement date, the lessor shall not derecognize the underlying asset but shall recognize lease payments received—including variable lease payments—as a deposit liability until the earlier of either of the following:

  1. a

Collectibility of the lease payments, plus any amount necessary to satisfy a residual value guarantee provided by the lessee, becomes probable. If collectibility is not probable at the commencement date, a lessor shall continue to assess collectibility to determine whether the lease payments and any amount necessary to satisfy a residual value guarantee are probable of collection.

  2. b

Either of the following events occurs:

     1. 1

The [contract](/1943274/1794186/fasb-asc-publication/contract "An agreement between two or more parties that creates enforceable rights and obligations.") has been terminated, and the lease payments received from the lessee are nonrefundable.

     2. 2

The lessor has repossessed the underlying asset, it has no further obligation under the contract to the lessee, and the lease payments received from the lessee are nonrefundable.

notwithstanding, if collectibility of the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor."), plus any amount necessary to satisfy a [residual value guarantee](/1943274/1823121/fasb-asc-publication/residual-value-guarantee "A guarantee made to a lessor that the value of an underlying asset returned to the lessor at the end of a lease will be at least a specified amount.") provided by the [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration."), is not [probable](/1943274/1818955/fasb-asc-publication/probable "The future event or events are likely to occur.") at the commencement date, the lessor shall not derecognize the underlying asset but shall recognize lease payments received—including variable lease payments—as a deposit liability until the earlier of either of the following:

  2. b

     1. 1

The [contract](/1943274/1794186/fasb-asc-publication/contract "An agreement between two or more parties that creates enforceable rights and obligations.") has been terminated, and the lease payments received from the lessee are nonrefundable.

     2. 2

When collectibility is not probable at the commencement date, at the date the criterion in paragraph [842-30-25-3(a)](/1943274/2147479341/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77919095-209958__SL77919106-209958) is met (that is, the date at which collectibility of the lease payments plus any amount necessary to satisfy a residual value guarantee provided by the lessee is assessed as probable), the lessor shall do all of the following:

(provided by the [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") or any other unrelated third party) is not [probable](/1943274/1818955/fasb-asc-publication/probable "The future event or events are likely to occur.") at the commencement date, lease income shall be limited to the lesser of the income that would be recognized in accordance with paragraph [842-30-25-11(a) through (b)](/1943274/2147479341/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77919137-209958__SL77919140-209958) or the lease payments, including variable lease payments, that have been collected from the lessee.

842-30-25-12

(provided by the [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") or any other unrelated third party) is not [probable](/1943274/1818955/fasb-asc-publication/probable "The future event or events are likely to occur.") at the commencement date, lease income shall be limited to the lesser of the income that would be recognized in accordance with paragraph [842-30-25-11(a) through (b)](/1943274/2147479341/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77919137-209958__SL77919140-209958) or the lease payments, including variable lease payments, that have been collected from the lessee.

842-30-25-13

If the assessment of collectibility changes after the commencement date, any difference between the lease income that would have been recognized in accordance with paragraph [842-30-25-11(a) through (b)](/1943274/2147479341/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77919137-209958__SL77919140-209958) and the lease payments, including variable lease payments, that have been collected from the lessee shall be recognized as a current-period adjustment to lease income.

842-30-25-13

If the assessment of collectibility changes after the commencement date, any difference between the lease income that would have been recognized in accordance with paragraph [842-30-25-11(a) through (b)](/1943274/2147479341/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77919137-209958__SL77919140-209958) and the lease payments, including variable lease payments, that have been collected from the lessee shall be recognized as a current-period adjustment to lease income.

) for an illustration of the requirements when collectibility is not probable.

# 30 Initial Measurement

General Note:

The Initial Measurement Section provides guidance on the criteria and amounts used to measure a particular item at the date of initial recognition.

## General

### > Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases

842-30-30-1

At the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), for a [sales-type lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A."), a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall measure the [net investment in the lease](/1943274/1813053/fasb-asc-publication/net-investment-in-the-lease "For a sales-type lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset. For a direct financing lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit.") to include both of the following:

  1. a

However, if the rate determined in accordance with the preceding sentence is less than zero, a rate implicit in the lease of zero shall be used."), of:

     1. 1

The [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") (as described in paragraph [842-10-30-5](/1943274/2147479924/fasb-asc-publication/initial-measurement#SL77916638-209961__SL77916639-209961)) not yet received by the lessor

     2. 2

The amount the lessor expects to derive from the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee.   2. b

The [unguaranteed residual asset](/1943274/1830843/fasb-asc-publication/unguaranteed-residual-asset "The amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term that is not guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.") at the present value of the amount the lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term that is not guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, discounted using the rate implicit in the lease.

However, if the rate determined in accordance with the preceding sentence is less than zero, a rate implicit in the lease of zero shall be used."), of:

     1. 1

(as described in paragraph [842-10-30-5](/1943274/2147479924/fasb-asc-publication/initial-measurement#SL77916638-209961__SL77916639-209961)) not yet received by the lessor

  2. b

The [unguaranteed residual asset](/1943274/1830843/fasb-asc-publication/unguaranteed-residual-asset "The amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term that is not guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.") at the present value of the amount the lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term that is not guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, discounted using the rate implicit in the lease.

# 35 Subsequent Measurement

General Note:

The Subsequent Measurement Section provides guidance on an entity's subsequent measurement and subsequent recognition of an item. Situations that may result in subsequent changes to carrying amount include impairment, credit losses, fair value adjustments, depreciation and amortization, and so forth.

## General

### > Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases

842-30-35-1

After the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall measure the [net investment in the lease](/1943274/1813053/fasb-asc-publication/net-investment-in-the-lease "For a sales-type lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset. For a direct financing lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit.") by doing both of the following:

  1. a

Increasing the carrying amount to reflect the interest income on the net investment in the lease. A lessor shall determine the interest income on the net investment in the lease in each period during the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor.") as the amount that produces a constant periodic discount rate on the remaining balance of the net investment in the lease.

  2. b

Reducing the carrying amount to reflect the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") collected during the period.




842-30-35-1

After the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall measure the [net investment in the lease](/1943274/1813053/fasb-asc-publication/net-investment-in-the-lease "For a sales-type lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset. For a direct financing lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit.") by doing both of the following:

  1. a

Increasing the carrying amount to reflect the interest income on the net investment in the lease. A lessor shall determine the interest income on the net investment in the lease in each period during the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor.") as the amount that produces a constant periodic discount rate on the remaining balance of the net investment in the lease.

  2. b

Reducing the carrying amount to reflect the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") collected during the period.




842-30-35-2

After the commencement date, a lessor shall not remeasure the net investment in the lease unless the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") is modified and that modification is not accounted for as a separate [contract](/1943274/1794186/fasb-asc-publication/contract "An agreement between two or more parties that creates enforceable rights and obligations.") in accordance with paragraph [842-10-25-8](/1943274/2147479948/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77916525-209956__SL77916526-209956).

842-30-35-2

After the commencement date, a lessor shall not remeasure the net investment in the lease unless the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") is modified and that modification is not accounted for as a separate [contract](/1943274/1794186/fasb-asc-publication/contract "An agreement between two or more parties that creates enforceable rights and obligations.") in accordance with paragraph [842-10-25-8](/1943274/2147479948/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77916525-209956__SL77916526-209956).

#### · > Loss Allowance on the Net Investment in the Lease

842-30-35-3

A [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall determine the loss allowance related to the [net investment in the lease](/1943274/1813053/fasb-asc-publication/net-investment-in-the-lease "For a sales-type lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset. For a direct financing lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit.") and shall record any loss allowance in accordance with Subtopic 326-20 on financial instruments measured at amortized cost. When determining the loss allowance for a net investment in the lease, a lessor shall take into consideration the collateral relating to the net investment in the lease. The collateral relating to the net investment in the lease represents the cash flows that the lessor would expect to receive (or derive) from the [lease receivable](/1943274/1808911/fasb-asc-publication/lease-receivable "A lessor's right to receive lease payments arising from a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease plus any amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term to the extent that it is guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.") and the [unguaranteed residual asset](/1943274/1830843/fasb-asc-publication/unguaranteed-residual-asset "The amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term that is not guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.") during and following the end of the remaining [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor.").

For a direct financing lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit.") and shall record any loss allowance in accordance with Subtopic 326-20 on financial instruments measured at amortized cost. When determining the loss allowance for a net investment in the lease, a lessor shall take into consideration the collateral relating to the net investment in the lease. The collateral relating to the net investment in the lease represents the cash flows that the lessor would expect to receive (or derive) from the [lease receivable](/1943274/1808911/fasb-asc-publication/lease-receivable "A lessor's right to receive lease payments arising from a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease plus any amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term to the extent that it is guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.") and the [unguaranteed residual asset](/1943274/1830843/fasb-asc-publication/unguaranteed-residual-asset "The amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term that is not guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.") during and following the end of the remaining [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor.").

#### · > Sale of the Lease Receivable

842-30-35-4

If a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") sells substantially all of the [lease receivable](/1943274/1808911/fasb-asc-publication/lease-receivable "A lessor's right to receive lease payments arising from a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease plus any amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term to the extent that it is guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.") associated with a [sales-type lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.") or a [direct financing lease](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets none of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 but meets the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-3\(b\)and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.") and retains an interest in the [unguaranteed residual asset](/1943274/1830843/fasb-asc-publication/unguaranteed-residual-asset "The amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term that is not guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis."), the lessor shall not continue to accrete the unguaranteed residual asset to its estimated value over the remaining [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor."). The lessor shall report any remaining unguaranteed residual asset thereafter at its carrying amount at the date of the sale of the lease receivable and apply Topic 360 on property, plant, and equipment to determine whether the unguaranteed residual asset is impaired.

lease](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets none of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 but meets the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-3\(b\)and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.") and retains an interest in the [unguaranteed residual asset](/1943274/1830843/fasb-asc-publication/unguaranteed-residual-asset "The amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term that is not guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis."), the lessor shall not continue to accrete the unguaranteed residual asset to its estimated value over the remaining [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor."). The lessor shall report any remaining unguaranteed residual asset thereafter at its carrying amount at the date of the sale of the lease receivable and apply Topic 360 on property, plant, and equipment to determine whether the unguaranteed residual asset is impaired.

#### · > Accounting for the Underlying Asset at the End of the Lease Term

842-30-35-5

At the end of the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor."), a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall reclassify the [net investment in the lease](/1943274/1813053/fasb-asc-publication/net-investment-in-the-lease "For a sales-type lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset. For a direct financing lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit.") to the appropriate category of asset (for example, property, plant, and equipment) in accordance with other Topics, measured at the carrying amount of the net investment in the lease. The lessor shall account for the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") that was the subject of a [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") in accordance with other Topics.

842-30-35-5

At the end of the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor."), a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall reclassify the [net investment in the lease](/1943274/1813053/fasb-asc-publication/net-investment-in-the-lease "For a sales-type lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset. For a direct financing lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit.") to the appropriate category of asset (for example, property, plant, and equipment) in accordance with other Topics, measured at the carrying amount of the net investment in the lease. The lessor shall account for the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") that was the subject of a [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") in accordance with other Topics.

### > Operating Leases

### > Subleases

# 40 Derecognition

General Note:

The Derecognition Section provides guidance on determining whether and when an entity should remove an item from the financial statements. For example, the entity would derecognize an asset because it no longer has rights to the asset or it would derecognize a liability because it no longer has any obligation.

## General

### > Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases

842-30-40-1

At the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall derecognize the carrying amount of the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") (if previously recognized) unless the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") is a [sales-type lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.") and collectibility of the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") is not [probable](/1943274/1818955/fasb-asc-publication/probable "The future event or events are likely to occur.") (see paragraph [842-30-25-3](/1943274/2147479341/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77919095-209958__SL77919106-209958)).

842-30-40-1

At the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date."), a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall derecognize the carrying amount of the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") (if previously recognized) unless the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") is a [sales-type lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.") and collectibility of the [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") is not [probable](/1943274/1818955/fasb-asc-publication/probable "The future event or events are likely to occur.") (see paragraph [842-30-25-3](/1943274/2147479341/fasb-asc-publication/recognition#SL77919095-209958__SL77919106-209958)).

#### · > Lease Termination

842-30-40-2

If a [sales-type lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.") or a [direct financing lease](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets none of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 but meets the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-3\(b\)and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.") is terminated before the end of the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor."), a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall do all of the following:

  1. a

Measure the [net investment in the lease](/1943274/1813053/fasb-asc-publication/net-investment-in-the-lease "For a sales-type lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset. For a direct financing lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit.") for credit losses in accordance with Subtopic 326-20 on financial instruments measured at amortized cost and record any credit loss identified

  2. b

Reclassify the net investment in the lease to the appropriate category of asset in accordance with other Topics, measured at the sum of the carrying amounts of the [lease receivable](/1943274/1808911/fasb-asc-publication/lease-receivable "A lessor's right to receive lease payments arising from a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease plus any amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term to the extent that it is guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.") (less any amounts still expected to be received by the lessor) and the residual asset

  3. c

Account for the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") that was the subject of the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") in accordance with other Topics.




842-30-40-2

If a [sales-type lease](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.") or a [direct financing lease](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets none of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 but meets the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-3\(b\)and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.") is terminated before the end of the [lease term](/1943274/1808936/fasb-asc-publication/lease-term "The noncancellable period for which a lessee has the right to use an underlying asset, together with all of the following: Periods covered by an option to extend the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to terminate the lease if the lessee is reasonably certain not to exercise that option Periods covered by an option to extend \(or not to terminate\) the lease in which exercise of the option is controlled by the lessor."), a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall do all of the following:

  1. a

Measure the [net investment in the lease](/1943274/1813053/fasb-asc-publication/net-investment-in-the-lease "For a sales-type lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset. For a direct financing lease, the sum of the lease receivable and the unguaranteed residual asset, net of any deferred selling profit.") for credit losses in accordance with Subtopic 326-20 on financial instruments measured at amortized cost and record any credit loss identified

  2. b

Reclassify the net investment in the lease to the appropriate category of asset in accordance with other Topics, measured at the sum of the carrying amounts of the [lease receivable](/1943274/1808911/fasb-asc-publication/lease-receivable "A lessor's right to receive lease payments arising from a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease plus any amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term to the extent that it is guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.") (less any amounts still expected to be received by the lessor) and the residual asset

  3. c

Account for the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") that was the subject of the [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") in accordance with other Topics.




#### · > Subleases

842-30-40-3

If the original [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") agreement is replaced by a new agreement with a new [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration."), the [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall account for the termination of the original lease as provided in paragraph [842-30-40-2](/1943274/2147479066/fasb-asc-publication/derecognition#SL77919275-209976__SL77919276-209976) and shall classify and account for the new lease as a separate transaction.

842-30-40-3

If the original [lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") agreement is replaced by a new agreement with a new [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration."), the [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall account for the termination of the original lease as provided in paragraph [842-30-40-2](/1943274/2147479066/fasb-asc-publication/derecognition#SL77919275-209976__SL77919276-209976) and shall classify and account for the new lease as a separate transaction.

# 45 Other Presentation Matters

General Note:

The Other Presentation Matters Section provides guidance on other presentation matters not addressed in the Recognition, Initial Measurement, Subsequent Measurement, and Derecognition Sections. Other presentation matters may include items such as current or long-term balance sheet classification, cash flow presentation, earnings per share matters, and so forth. The FASB Codification also contains Presentation Topics, which provide guidance for general presentation and display items. See those Topics for general guidance.

## General

### > Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases

#### · > Statement of Financial Position

842-30-45-1

A [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall present lease assets (that is, the aggregate of the lessor's net investment in [sales-type leases](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.") and [direct financing leases](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets none of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 but meets the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-3\(b\)and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.")) separately from other assets in the statement of financial position.

842-30-45-1

A [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall present lease assets (that is, the aggregate of the lessor's net investment in [sales-type leases](/1943274/1824722/fasb-asc-publication/sales-type-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.") and [direct financing leases](/1943274/1797910/fasb-asc-publication/direct-financing-lease "From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets none of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 but meets the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-3\(b\)and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.")) separately from other assets in the statement of financial position.

842-30-45-2

[Lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") assets shall be subject to the same considerations as other assets in classification as current or noncurrent assets in a classified balance sheet.

842-30-45-2

[Lease](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") assets shall be subject to the same considerations as other assets in classification as current or noncurrent assets in a classified balance sheet.

#### · > Statement of Comprehensive Income

842-30-45-3

A [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall either present in the statement of comprehensive income or disclose in the notes income arising from [leases](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration."). If a lessor does not separately present lease income in the statement of comprehensive income, the lessor shall disclose which line items include lease income in the statement of comprehensive income.

842-30-45-3

A [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall either present in the statement of comprehensive income or disclose in the notes income arising from [leases](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration."). If a lessor does not separately present lease income in the statement of comprehensive income, the lessor shall disclose which line items include lease income in the statement of comprehensive income.

842-30-45-4

A lessor shall present any profit or loss on the lease recognized at the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date.") in a manner that best reflects the lessor's business model(s). Examples of presentation include the following:

  1. a

If a lessor uses leases as an alternative means of realizing value from the goods that it would otherwise sell, the lessor shall present revenue and cost of goods sold relating to its leasing activities in separate line items so that income and expenses from sold and leased items are presented consistently. Revenue recognized is the lesser of:

     1. 1

The [fair value](/1943274/1801222/fasb-asc-publication/fair-value "The price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date.") of the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") at the commencement date

     2. 2

The sum of the [lease receivable](/1943274/1808911/fasb-asc-publication/lease-receivable "A lessor's right to receive lease payments arising from a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease plus any amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term to the extent that it is guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.") and any [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") prepaid by the [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration."). 

Cost of goods sold is the carrying amount of the underlying asset at the commencement date minus the [unguaranteed residual asset](/1943274/1830843/fasb-asc-publication/unguaranteed-residual-asset "The amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term that is not guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.").
  2. b

If a lessor uses leases for the purposes of providing finance, the lessor shall present the profit or loss in a single line item.




842-30-45-4

A lessor shall present any profit or loss on the lease recognized at the [commencement date](/1943274/1792539/fasb-asc-publication/commencement-date-of-the-lease-commencement-date- "The date on which a lessor makes an underlying asset available for use by a lessee. See paragraphs 842-10-55-19842-10-55-20842-10-55-21 for implementation guidance on the commencement date.") in a manner that best reflects the lessor's business model(s). Examples of presentation include the following:

  1. a

If a lessor uses leases as an alternative means of realizing value from the goods that it would otherwise sell, the lessor shall present revenue and cost of goods sold relating to its leasing activities in separate line items so that income and expenses from sold and leased items are presented consistently. Revenue recognized is the lesser of:

     1. 1

The [fair value](/1943274/1801222/fasb-asc-publication/fair-value "The price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date.") of the [underlying asset](/1943274/1830585/fasb-asc-publication/underlying-asset "An asset that is the subject of a lease for which a right to use that asset has been conveyed to a lessee. The underlying asset could be a physically distinct portion of a single asset.") at the commencement date

     2. 2

The sum of the [lease receivable](/1943274/1808911/fasb-asc-publication/lease-receivable "A lessor's right to receive lease payments arising from a sales-type lease or a direct financing lease plus any amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term to the extent that it is guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.") and any [lease payments](/1943274/1808885/fasb-asc-publication/lease-payments "See paragraph 842-10-30-5 for what constitutes lease payments from the perspective of a lessee and a lessor.") prepaid by the [lessee](/1943274/1809105/fasb-asc-publication/lessee "An entity that enters into a contract to obtain the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration."). 

Cost of goods sold is the carrying amount of the underlying asset at the commencement date minus the [unguaranteed residual asset](/1943274/1830843/fasb-asc-publication/unguaranteed-residual-asset "The amount that a lessor expects to derive from the underlying asset following the end of the lease term that is not guaranteed by the lessee or any other third party unrelated to the lessor, measured on a discounted basis.").
  2. b

If a lessor uses leases for the purposes of providing finance, the lessor shall present the profit or loss in a single line item.




#### · > Statement of Cash Flows

842-30-45-5

In the statement of cash flows, a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall classify cash receipts from [leases](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") within operating activities. However, if the lessor is within the scope of Topic 942 on financial services—depository and lending, it shall follow the guidance in paragraph [942-230-45-4](/1943274/2147479024/fasb-asc-publication/other-presentation#pgroup_F2C4A12B-6E93-1014-A13F-6E4B94C84136__SL120154370-112784) for the presentation of principal payments received from leases.

842-30-45-5

In the statement of cash flows, a [lessor](/1943274/1809131/fasb-asc-publication/lessor "An entity that enters into a contract to provide the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") shall classify cash receipts from [leases](/1943274/1808716/fasb-asc-publication/lease "A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to control the use of identified property, plant, or equipment \(an identified asset\) for a period of time in exchange for consideration.") within operating activities. However, if the lessor is within the scope of Topic 942 on financial services—depository and lending, it shall follow the guidance in paragraph [942-230-45-4](/1943274/2147479024/fasb-asc-publication/other-presentation#pgroup_F2C4A12B-6E93-1014-A13F-6E4B94C84136__SL120154370-112784) for the presentation of principal payments received from leases.
